validation_tests.scope: Existing public-parity Guide validation suite; not a new export.

work_scope.capability: Live Answer goal-context refresh and unresolved objective display
work_scope.authority_owner: Existing server query and mission controller
work_scope.required_evidence: Null response regression before/after, Guide suite, scoped compiler and compile
work_scope.explicit_non_goals: No goal execution, room admission, pairing, action, provider or server contract changes

review: A successful goal-context endpoint response containing JSON null previously threw before the two context arrays could be cleared. The existing readRecord guard now normalizes non-object responses to the existing empty-record fallback; successful object arrays and query URL remain unchanged.

Eleven tests execute the actual panel response initializer and its two setter statements. Before the change, the null response failed and ten cases passed. Cases cover successful arrays, null/primitives/array/missing-field bodies, HTTP refusal, malformed JSON and network failure.

The Guide unresolved-objective filter now declares the exact type narrowing of its existing resolved exclusion. Sorting, display and controller authority are unchanged; emitted-code equality is checked.
Both existing production files matched public preview bytes before these narrow changes. The new source slice qualifies only the reviewed diff, not every behavior of those large panels.
limits: Unfrozen, unpublished, uninstalled. Statement-level tests do not mount the complete Live Answer panel or prove end-to-end GPT Live context delivery.
Nested array entries retain the existing server-contract assumptions; this is outer-response normalization, not a full schema validator.
The export boundary tests read the actual preview panel. Existing Guide tests load the selected exported Guide module with canonical dependencies.
